about.title: About Me
about.paragraph1: As a former automotive mechatronics technician, I discovered my passion for software development through my enthusiasm for technical systems and structured problem-solving. Today, I build modern web applications with Angular while continuously expanding my frontend and backend skills.
about.paragraph2: What excites me most isn't just writing code—it's understanding how complex systems work. I enjoy learning new technologies, continuously improving my code and creating clean, maintainable solutions.
